options.name: from_time
options.description: Starting epoch time in hours for alarms query. If not provided, the module will retrieve alarms from the beginning of time.

options.name: log_file
options.description: Path to a file where the alarms will be logged in JSON format. If not provided, alarms will not be logged to a file.

options.name: manager_credentials
options.description: Credentials to authenticate with the vManage instance.

options.name: mark_all_as_viewed
options.description: Whether to mark all the alarms as viewed.

options.name: only_critical
options.description: Whether to retrieve only alarms with CRITICAL severity.
